title: Simulation Result
description: Raw provenance-tagged output of one DECK-BACKED simulation run, per docs/VERSIONING.md and docs/RUN_CLASSIFICATION.md. Lives at results/raw/<run_id>/config.json (this schema) plus a sibling games.jsonl or games/ directory of per-game records (schema not yet defined — depends on the state representation chosen once sim/ exists). Synthetic laboratory fixtures (gold board states/games) NEVER use this schema — see gold_board_state.schema.json / gold_game.schema.json and docs/RUN_CLASSIFICATION.md. A run conforming to this schema is, by construction, empirical evidence about the actual subject/opponent decks, never a rules-only laboratory check.

run_class.description: Per docs/RUN_CLASSIFICATION.md. This schema is reserved for deck-backed runs only - a synthetic fixture is structurally incapable of satisfying subject_deck_hash (see sim/validation/run_classification.py's load_frozen_deck() guard, which refuses to load anything carrying a SYNTHETIC_* run_class or representative_of_deck_draws=false).

evidence_type.description: goldfish for DECK_BACKED_GOLDFISH runs, simulation for DECK_BACKED_SINGLE_PLAYER/DECK_BACKED_FOUR_PLAYER. practice_game/tournament_game/static_probability results use a different, lighter record — see docs/VERSIONING.md.

simulator_version.description: git SHA of sim/ at run time.

subject_deck_version.description: Must resolve to a frozen data/decklists/<version>.json file — never data/decklists/_provisional/.

subject_deck_hash.description: Canonical SHA-256 deck hash (sim/validation/run_classification.py's compute_deck_hash()), must match the frozen decklist file's own deck_hash field exactly.

subject_deck_card_count.description: Exact card count of the loaded deck, checked against the frozen file.

commander_identities.description: Checked against the frozen decklist file's commanders field.

basics_substituted.description: Must be false unless this run is a declared ablation (charter: never silently simplify). True requires ablation_justification to also be present and non-empty.

ablation_justification.description: Required non-null/non-empty when basics_substituted is true; must explain what's being tested by the substitution and why. Null/omitted when basics_substituted is false.

opponent_deck_versions.description: Empty for DECK_BACKED_GOLDFISH/DECK_BACKED_SINGLE_PLAYER (no opponents); one entry per opposing seat for DECK_BACKED_FOUR_PLAYER.

opponent_deck_hashes.description: One canonical deck hash per entry in opponent_deck_versions, same order, same hash-check requirement as subject_deck_hash.

known_coverage_gaps.description: coverage_backlog entry IDs open at run time and relevant to this run's scope.

gate_status_at_run_time.description: Snapshot of docs/VALIDATION_GATES.md gate statuses at run time, so a result carries its own validation context even if the gates file changes later.

confidence.description: Per docs/VERSIONING.md confidence dimensions. Populated when the run is used to support a Findings Packet, may be null for exploratory/internal runs.
